runtime.command_template: python tools/run_pinmame_harness.py --library <libpinmame> --game galaxy --rom-path <vpinmame-roms> --work-dir <new-isolated-state> --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/stern/galaxy-<run>.json --output <external-run.json>, for run in self-test, solenoid-test, switch-test, gameplay and game-over-and-slam, and the same with --game galaxyb and tools/harness-scenarios/stern/galaxyb-solenoid-test.json. Each scenario starts with a 25 s wait for the ROM's power-up test.

galaxyb-solenoid-test.note: Driver galaxyb (the seven-digit conversion clone, ROM archive SHA-256 cfba29a71b9fe8e0d108527773f0a5b988078591c88493f4e1a1be720fc4ed52), the same four Self Test presses and the same reading: over 3 complete cycles its solenoid test pairs driver numbers 1-19 with the same public addresses as the production ROM's. Every other run boots galaxy.

self-test.limitation: The burn-in drives the displays with digit-cycling frames, so the driver numbers are read from the solenoid-test run instead.
self-test.note: One Self Test press starts the burn-in test. All sixty lamp addresses (60 seen) are driven and the four decoder holes 16, 32, 48 and 64 never are; the solenoids fire in a repeating 19-step cycle.

solenoid-test.note: Four Self Test presses start the solenoid test, which pulses one driver at a time and shows its number on the Player displays (read 0.25 s after each pulse). Over 3 complete cycles, driver numbers 1-19 pair with public addresses 1->2, 2->1, 3->6, 4->7, 5->3, 6->4, 7->5, 8->8, 9->11, 10->12, 11->14, 12->13, 13->9, 14->10, 15->19, 16->15, 17->17, 18->20, 19->18.

source.manifest_algorithm: source.sha256 is a directory manifest digest, not a file hash: list every file below source.path as {path, size, sha256} with path relative and POSIX-separated, sort by path, serialise as compact canonical JSON (indent=None, separators=(',',':'), sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False), encode UTF-8 and take the SHA-256. At capture time the tree held 42 files totalling 13810121 bytes. Individual run hashes are in runtime.raw_runs[].sha256.
